tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The editor ground: the note itself fills the window on paper.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, status line and hint bars, one step off paper.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Every modal: finder, explorer, palette, capture, review.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Code blocks, inline code, tag chips and the cursor line, on paper or overlay.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal, over the editor. Never on its own.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panes, columns and bars.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Modal edges, keycap outlines, unchecked task boxes: marks that must read at 3:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Note text and primary UI text, on paper, chrome, overlay and well.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hint labels, preview body, folder names, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Markdown markers (#, **, - [ ]), line numbers, metadata. 4.5:1 on paper and overlay.

tokens.name: cursor
tokens.usage: The brand colour: the block cursor, NORMAL mode, checked tasks, the focused split's top rule. One accent, used sparingly.

tokens.name: on-cursor
tokens.usage: Text or glyph drawn on a cursor fill, such as the character under the block cursor.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: The selected row in every list, and visual-mode selection.

tokens.name: select-ink
tokens.usage: Text on select; also wikilinks and links on paper.

tokens.name: match
tokens.usage: Search hits inside text. Text on it keeps ink.

tokens.name: insert
tokens.usage: INSERT mode pill text and the capture prompt; on insert-wash.

tokens.name: insert-wash
tokens.usage: INSERT mode pill fill; cut (pending move) rows in the explorer.

tokens.name: visual
tokens.usage: VISUAL mode pill text; on visual-wash.

tokens.name: visual-wash
tokens.usage: VISUAL mode pill fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Trash and destructive rows in the change review; always with a verb (trash, delete).

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind a danger label.

tokens.name: syn-heading
tokens.usage: Headings and their # markers in source view.

tokens.name: syn-strong
tokens.usage: Bold text with its ** markers in source view; bold stays this colour in styled view only in source.

tokens.name: syn-link
tokens.usage: Link text, [label] in source view and every link and wikilink in styled view.

tokens.name: syn-url
tokens.usage: The (url) part of a link and bare URLs in source view.

tokens.name: syn-marker
tokens.usage: List bullets, table pipes and quote markers in source view.

tokens.name: syn-code
tokens.usage: Strings in code blocks; inline code in source view.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords in code blocks.

families.prose: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: note-title
styles.usage: The note's H1, once per note.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: List rows, preview text, dialog body.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Dialog titles, file names in grouped results.

styles.name: note-body
styles.sample: The editor owns the window. Everything else is a modal.
styles.usage: All note text: paragraphs, lists, quotes, table cells, and the line numbers beside them. Mono, sized like Zed's editor.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, the oil-style folder buffer.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: The query line of every picker.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Mode pills, keycaps and hint bars.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Keycap padding, gap inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between hints.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Modal inner padding, list inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter between the line-number column and text; pane padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above headings; around the capture panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of a note.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keycaps, mode pills, selected rows, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, inputs, buttons, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Every modal. The only shadow in mNote.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the note column (80 characters of note-body).

tokens.name: modal-w
tokens.usage: Finder, explorer and palette width; below 700px of window they go full width and stack the preview.

tokens.name: capture-w
tokens.usage: Quick capture panel width.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar, status line and hint bar height.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: One list row in any picker or column.

tokens.name: gutter-w
tokens.usage: Line-number column: numbers right-aligned, then a 32px gap (space-8) before the text, so numbers never crowd the note.
